title: Deliver Rubber to Padhead Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Rubber** delivered to **Padhead Factory** (industry id 10, near tile 147,224).

A likely supplier is **Padhead Rubber Plantation** (industry id 13, near tile 146,248); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **31,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
